items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I heard quite a few Dixieland bands... Chris Kelly, Punch, Rene, Papa Celestine, they were all young comers then... Kid Punch would come out there... Punch was a powerful trumpet man

ctx.x: sixty-three, sixty-four. Before you started playing, did you listen to many bands before

you ever touched a horn? Oh yeah, I heard quite a few Dixieland bands. In those days they had all these good colored bands around town. Chris Kelly, Punch, Rene, Papa Celestine, they were all young comers then, you know what I mean? And they all played a powerful lot of music. Buddy Petit played nice stuff those days. Punch, Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly. Oh and they had quite a few good white bands. Pansaline had a good white Dixieland band. Johnny Beisdorff was at his peak. He was playing the Tokyo Gardens out at the…
